title: Massive-scale online collaboration | Luis von Ahn
summary: Luis von Ahn, creator of CAPTCHA and reCAPTCHA, explains how small contributions from many people online can digitize books. He then introduces Duolingo as a way to translate the web while people learn languages.
why: HN commenters recommend it as the clearest account of human computation and games with a purpose, straight from the inventor.

quote.text: I highly recommend watching the TED talk by Luis von Ahn, creater of CAPTCHA and reCAPTCHA.
